tips.text: Farm clamps in Isleweaver: you play your own Warframe on a small map and the boss dies faster than the Orowyrm.
Run Isleweaver on normal unless Steel Path takes you about as long; it pays 15 clamps instead of 10.
Bring Electricity damage for the Fragmented; it is weak to it.
In the Orowyrm's second phase, stay on foot or fly a mobile frame like Titania and shoot the wyrmlings instead of riding the Kaithe.
Use your amp in Operator mode on Isleweaver to speed the fight up.
On Steel Path Duviri, run the three bonus Undercroft portals after grabbing easy non-combat decrees; one player got about 24 clamps in 18 to 20 minutes.
Gather crafting plants in normal Duviri: pick up one decree, then leave, and the loot is saved.
Expect the 60 clamps to feel easy once Isleweaver is open; players end up with more than they can spend.
